summary: Operator's site shows 'Closed' and Google names it 'CLOSED FOR RENOVATIONS': recorded temporarily_closed with no reopening date. Hookups 50A/water/sewer, pull-throughs, store and laundry from the operator's pages; note-derived site count 400 cleared (operator states none). No posted rate.
flags: GATE FACTS: no rate posted anywhere on the operator's site; no booking engine ('Book Now' is a Google Form that asks for dates); RV Life 4*/$ (stored tier 1); not found in the cached Good Sam directory; no gateway within 40 km (Columbus 134 km). GOOGLE MAPS: 3.8 from 52 reviews, phone 740-685-7067 matches. Newest reviews I could read are about 2 years old (Newest sort did not load), positive and owner-answered; older ones (8-13 years) are harsh.

CLOSURE: home page text is just 'Closed' (no date or reason), and the Google business name is 'Buffalo Hills RV Resort "CLOSED FOR RENOVATIONS"'. A pages-stale sign: the amenities page still says '400,000 gallon pool (coming for the 2025 Season)'. So reopened-2024 no longer describes it. The operator publishes no reopening date. Worth a human decision on whether it should stay at all: AWH's rule keeps a temporarily closed park with a dated caveat, but nothing here says when or whether it comes back.

LONG-STAY TEST 2 and 5: long-stay in character. Operator: 'Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Seasonal and Yearly Rentals', and imagery shows dense settled lots with sheds and decks. No nightly price and no engine = test 2 failure. A dated lot-sale listing (rvparkstore, posted 2011, updated 2013, this address) says 'Most of our deeded lots are 40x80 and are sold as deeded property that you own forever'; 'over 100 campsites currently available' for 360 acres. It predates the 2024 management change, so whether lots are still deeded or sold is unverified; it could explain the dense lots (test 5).

PIN: stored 39.8952,-81.4318 is about 490 m NNW of the lots, in trees north of the loops. Lots' centre on imagery about 39.8911,-81.4295; office at the Google point 39.8896,-81.4314 (54780 Opossum Run Rd).

WATERFRONT LEAD: operator sells premium lots with 'Water View' (the stocked ponds); stored not waterfront. Imagery shows the two ponds south of the office, apart from the RV loops. A pond view at premium lots only, no change suggested.
4WD/fit: none stated; 'All LOTS ARE LARGE'. No max rig length posted.
